subject: Learning Methods
title: Flow Triggers
description: A fast breakdown of Flow Triggers for builders.

hook.text: Researchers found that certain conditions reliably increase the chance of entering flow. They are learnable.

buildup.text: Clear goals, immediate feedback, and deep concentration are the three core psychological triggers.

discovery.text: Environmental triggers include novelty, complexity, and unpredictability. These grab attention and hold it.

twist.text: Social flow exists too. Group brainstorming with equal participation and shared risk can trigger collective flow.

climax.text: Stack multiple triggers. Clear goal plus tight deadline plus novel problem dramatically increases your flow odds.

punchline.text: Flow is not luck. Stack the triggers and it comes.

quiz.question: Which combination is most likely to trigger flow?
options: Clear goals, immediate feedback, and deep concentration
